title: Performance in JEE (Main) 2026
description: Candidates should be among the top 2,50,000 successful candidates (including all categories) in B.E./B.Tech. paper of JEE (Main) 2026.

title: Age Limit
description: Candidates should have been born on or after October 1, 2001. Five years age relaxation is given to SC, ST, and PwD candidates.

title: Number of attempts
description: A candidate can attempt JEE (Advanced) a maximum of two times in two consecutive years.

title: Appearance in Class XII (or equivalent) examination
description: A candidate should have appeared for the Class XII (or equivalent) examination for the first time in either 2025 or 2026 with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics.

title: Earlier admission at IITs
description: A candidate should NOT have been admitted to an IIT irrespective of whether or not the candidate continued in the programme or accepted an IIT seat by reporting online.
